en.t: Oh, so that is what you meant.

units.source_text: 人心真的是非常神奇的。

en.t: The human heart is truly very mysterious.

units.source_text: 这么看来，百姓们都被你们的忠义所感染，也都想学习呢。

en.t: Seen this way, the common people are all moved by your loyalty and righteousness, and they want to learn from it too.

units.source_text: 在改变从上而下的堕落风俗，能够产生很大的影响呢。

en.t: It can have a great influence in changing the corrupt customs that run from the top down.

units.source_text: 现如今盛行的全是我们根本不想看的净瑠璃啦，歌舞伎剧什么的，因此是非常好的时机。”

en.t: Nowadays, only joruri and kabuki plays and the like, things we never really wanted to see, are popular, so this is a very good moment.
